rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL

GAME MOVE
Let Choose Charged begin the game. Let Return Seen end it.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WORD MELT // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Choose Charged — Choose one charged word—not a whole painful story.
2. Say Gently — Say it gently and steadily for about twenty seconds.
3. Listen Moment — Listen for the moment it becomes rhythm, mouth movement, or noise.
4. Stop Room — Stop there and look around the room.
5. Return Seen — Meaning may return; you have seen it separate once.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Return Seen and leave the game there.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Give yourself one second before Choose Charged: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Listen Moment, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Return Seen, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: Repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.

rituals.title: SET THE CONVERSATION SIZE
rituals.name: SET THE CONVERSATION SIZE
rituals.unique_game_move: Begin with Read Bandwidth. Move straight through to Set Reopen—no extra analysing.
rituals.recognition_cue: When the message in your head has become sharper than the facts, Set The Conversation Size makes the invisible part of the pattern easier to catch.
rituals.situation: When the message in your head has become sharper than the facts, Set The Conversation Size makes the invisible part of the pattern easier to catch.
rituals.immediate_need: A conversation can be important and still need a smaller container today.
rituals.challenge: A conversation can be important and still need a smaller container today.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Communication & conflict

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
When the message in your head has become sharper than the facts, Set The Conversation Size makes the invisible part of the pattern easier to catch.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A conversation can be important and still need a smaller container today.

GAME MOVE
Begin with Read Bandwidth. Move straight through to Set Reopen—no extra analysing.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SET THE CONVERSATION SIZE // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Read Bandwidth — Choose your current safe bandwidth: ONE SENTENCE, THREE SENTENCES, or FULL CONVERSATION.
2. Choose Size — Name the purpose that must fit inside that size: acknowledge, request, pause, clarify, or repair.
3. Send Signal — Draft or say only the selected amount. Stop when the sentence limit is reached, even if more remains.
4. Set Reopen — Name when or under what condition the next level can reopen. If you cannot offer one, state that honestly without making a false promise.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Set Reopen and leave the game there.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Give yourself one second before Read Bandwidth: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Send Signal, replace “definitely” with an honest percentage.
3. When you reach Set Reopen, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: A conversation can be important and still need a smaller container today.

🎮 SET THE CONVERSATION SIZE // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Read Bandwidth — Choose your current safe bandwidth: ONE SENTENCE, THREE SENTENCES, or FULL CONVERSATION.
2. Choose Size — Name the purpose that must fit inside that size: acknowledge, request, pause, clarify, or repair.
3. Send Signal — Draft or say only the selected amount. Stop when the sentence limit is reached, even if more remains.
4. Set Reopen — Name when or under what condition the next level can reopen. If you cannot offer one, state that honestly without making a false promise.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Set Reopen and leave the game there.

1. Give yourself one second before Read Bandwidth: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Send Signal, replace “definitely” with an honest percentage.
3. When you reach Set Reopen, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: A conversation can be important and still need a smaller container today.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You notice the pull of the old pattern and can still choose Set Reopen.

“I separated what was said from what I added to it.”

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CHANGE ONE THING, WATCH ONE FEELING // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Name Pair — Name two emotions in the mixture and rate each with a simple low, medium, or high—not a number.
2. Hold Scene — Hold the scene steady. Choose only one variable to test: person, time, place, audience, or outcome.
3. Swap Variable — Imagine that one variable changed for ten seconds. Keep every other fact the same.
4. Tag Driver — Notice which emotion moved and which stayed. Tag the changed variable as a likely driver, not a final explanation.

⚡ DONE — Complete Tag Driver, then return to your day.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 TWO CHAIRS, NO TELEPATHY // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Place Chairs — Place two chairs apart.
2. Speak Position — Speak from your position using first person.
3. Switch Chair — Move and answer as the other position, labelling imagination where knowledge is missing.
4. Dont And — Return to your chair and state what changed, what did not, and what real conversation may still be needed.

⚡ FINISH — Dont And closes the round.

rituals.text_plain:

TRIGGER
Rigid beliefs, labels & stories

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
When one moment is turning into a whole story, Tell It At The Speed Of Safety helps you test what your mind is telling you.

GOAL
Disclosure should increase clarity, not steal control.

GAME MOVE
Enter through Choose Trustworthy; leave as soon as you reach End Support. One pass is enough.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 TELL IT AT THE SPEED OF SAFETY // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. Choose Trustworthy — Choose a trustworthy listener and agree on time, confidentiality, and a stop signal.
2. Share — Share facts first, then feelings and meaning in tolerable detail.
3. Pause Orient — Pause to orient between sections.
4. End Support — End with what support you want now—not what the listener guesses.

⚡ DONE — Complete End Support, then return to your day.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. At the start of Choose Trustworthy, widen your gaze and notice the edges of the room.
2. At Pause Orient, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach End Support, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep the clean version: Disclosure should increase clarity, not steal control.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
A small gap appears between the reaction and what you do at End Support.

📸 MY RESULT
“I caught the moment before it became the whole room.”

Choose Trustworthy → Share → Pause Orient → End Support

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 GROUNDING ANCHOR RELAY // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Select Different — Select four anchors from different systems: visual line, distant sound, contact pressure, joint position.
2. Switch Getting — Spend a short interval with each and switch before getting used to it empties it.
3. Finish Channel — Finish on the channel that restored the clearest present contact.

⚡ END MOVE — Finish Channel. No second lap.

HOW TO PLAY

Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 HALF-SPEED THE FIRST MOVE // PLAY

1. Identify Earliest — Spot the earliest movement linked to the urge—turning, reaching, standing, typing.
2. Observe Direction — Perform only that movement at half speed while observing its direction and tension.
3. Pause Completion — Pause at completion and decide whether the second movement serves you.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Pause Completion is your cue to stop.

rituals.title: DISASSEMBLE THE ALARM PANEL
rituals.name: DISASSEMBLE THE ALARM PANEL
rituals.unique_game_move: Enter through Read Channels; leave as soon as you reach Check Panel. One pass is enough.
rituals.recognition_cue: When your body alarm keeps turning itself up, Disassemble The Alarm Panel helps you test what your mind is telling you.
rituals.situation: When your body alarm keeps turning itself up, Disassemble The Alarm Panel helps you test what your mind is telling you.
rituals.immediate_need: The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.
rituals.challenge: The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
When your body alarm keeps turning itself up, Disassemble The Alarm Panel helps you test what your mind is telling you.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.

GAME MOVE
Enter through Read Channels; leave as soon as you reach Check Panel. One pass is enough.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 DISASSEMBLE THE ALARM PANEL // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. Read Channels — Read three channels without searching your whole body: SPEED, PRESSURE, and TEMPERATURE. Use low, medium, or high.
2. Pick Smallest — Choose the safest channel with the lowest intensity. Do not pick the loudest one.
3. Move Dial — Move only that channel one step: slow one hand movement, soften one contact point, or adjust one safe layer of warmth or coolness.
4. Check Panel — Check whether that channel changed at all. Let the other two channels remain exactly as they are.

⚡ DONE — Complete Check Panel, then return to your day.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. At the start of Read Channels, widen your gaze and notice the edges of the room.
2. At Move Dial, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Check Panel, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep the clean version: The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.

A small gap appears between the reaction and what you do at Check Panel.

rituals.plain:
DISASSEMBLE THE ALARM PANEL

TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
When your body alarm keeps turning itself up, Disassemble The Alarm Panel helps you test what your mind is telling you.

GOAL
The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.

GAME MOVE
Enter through Read Channels; leave as soon as you reach Check Panel. One pass is enough.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 DISASSEMBLE THE ALARM PANEL // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. Read Channels — Read three channels without searching your whole body: SPEED, PRESSURE, and TEMPERATURE. Use low, medium, or high.
2. Pick Smallest — Choose the safest channel with the lowest intensity. Do not pick the loudest one.
3. Move Dial — Move only that channel one step: slow one hand movement, soften one contact point, or adjust one safe layer of warmth or coolness.
4. Check Panel — Check whether that channel changed at all. Let the other two channels remain exactly as they are.

⚡ DONE — Complete Check Panel, then return to your day.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. At the start of Read Channels, widen your gaze and notice the edges of the room.
2. At Move Dial, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Check Panel, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep the clean version: The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
A small gap appears between the reaction and what you do at Check Panel.

📸 MY RESULT
“My body sounded an alarm; I didn't have to turn it into danger.”

FORMULA FLOW
Read Channels → Pick Smallest → Move Dial → Check Panel

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 RETURN THEIR ACTION; KEEP YOUR CHOICE // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Imagine Three Boxes — Imagine three boxes: WHAT THEY DID; WHAT I LEARNED; WHAT I CHOOSE NOW.
2. Keep Each Part — Keep each thought in the right box.

⚡ FINISH — Act From Choice closes the round.

GOAL

GAME MOVE
Begin where it says Name Task; stop the moment you complete Build Smallest.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE VERSION THAT STILL COUNTS // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Name Task — Name the task’s essential purpose.
2. Remove Feature — Remove every feature not required for that purpose.
3. Build Smallest — Build the smallest deliverable that still works, submit or finish it, then upgrade only if time and value justify the addition.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Build Smallest be enough.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Name Task, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Remove Feature, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Build Smallest, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Perfection should not be allowed to cancel function.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
The Room Has Jobs, Not Demands gives you a quick reset for the moment when your mind keeps delaying the first move.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A room becomes lighter when objects return to jobs instead of accusations.

GAME MOVE
Begin where it says Scan Objects; stop the moment you complete Choose Helper.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE ROOM HAS JOBS, NOT DEMANDS // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Scan Objects — Choose four safe visible objects without moving toward them. Avoid screens if they add strain.
2. Name Jobs — For each object, name only its ordinary job: chair supports, lamp lights, cup holds, door opens.
3. Drop Demands — Say ‘not needed now’ to every function that does not serve the current safe moment. Do not remove or organise anything.
4. Choose Helper — Choose the one object whose real function supports the next action, then use only that function.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Choose Helper be enough.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Scan Objects, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Drop Demands, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Choose Helper, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: A room becomes lighter when objects return to jobs instead of accusations.

rituals.how_to_play:

rituals.title: FIND YOUR WORKING GEAR
rituals.name: FIND YOUR WORKING GEAR
rituals.unique_game_move: Play from Run Pulse to Set Gear. Treat the last move as the finish line.
rituals.recognition_cue: Use Find Your Working Gear when your mind keeps delaying the first move. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.situation: Use Find Your Working Gear when your mind keeps delaying the first move. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.immediate_need: Motivation can guess; one work pulse can measure.
rituals.challenge: Motivation can guess; one work pulse can measure.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Use Find Your Working Gear when your mind keeps delaying the first move. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Motivation can guess; one work pulse can measure.

GAME MOVE
Play from Run Pulse to Set Gear. Treat the last move as the finish line.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 FIND YOUR WORKING GEAR // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Run Pulse — Choose one ordinary task and run it for exactly thirty seconds without trying to finish it.
2. Full Stop — Stop completely for fifteen seconds. Hands off, eyes away, and no planning the next move.
3. Read Strain — Rate actual strain as light, workable, heavy, or stop. Compare it with what you predicted before starting.
4. Set Gear — Choose the next gear—30/15, 60/30, or stop—and complete exactly one more cycle at that ratio.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Set Gear and release the exercise.
rituals.potency_stack:

TURN PURPOSE INTO A TUESDAY

TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Turn Purpose Into A Tuesday catches the moment when your mind keeps delaying the first move and gives you another route.

GOAL
Meaning needs a recurring appointment.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Picture Larger to Remove Inspirational.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 TURN PURPOSE INTO A TUESDAY // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Picture Larger — Picture the larger purpose, then spot one weekly behaviour that materially expresses it.
2. Choose Day — Choose day, cue, duration, and minimum version.
3. Remove Inspirational — Remove inspirational language until the procedure can survive an ordinary Tuesday.

⚡ FINISH — Remove Inspirational closes the round.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Picture Larger, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Choose Day, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Remove Inspirational, choose one action that fits the facts you found. If you remember one thing, make it this: Meaning needs a recurring appointment.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You arrive at Remove Inspirational with less need to obey the first answer.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped waiting to feel ready and found one move I could do.”

FORMULA FLOW
Picture Larger → Choose Day → Remove Inspirational

rituals.how_to_play:
🎮 CARRY FORWARD WITHOUT CALLING IT GOOD // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. State Clearly — State clearly what was wrong or unwanted.
2. Name Boundary — Then name one boundary, skill, loyalty, or value you can carry forward without claiming the event was beneficial.
3. Let Value — Let the value belong to you, not to the harm.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Let Value and release the exercise.
rituals.power_up_1: To open State Clearly, slow the next movement by about half.
rituals.power_up_2: At Name Boundary, separate responsibility from punishment.
rituals.power_up_3: When you reach Let Value, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Use this as the exit rule: Pain does not need approval to yield a chosen response.
rituals.win_reward_raw:
🏆 WIN SIGNAL
The pattern becomes easier to spot before you commit to Let Value.

📸 MY RESULT
“I just found where my responsibility ends.”
rituals.formula_flow_raw: State Clearly → Name Boundary → Let Value

GOAL

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE LAST-DAY FILTER // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Imagine Back — Imagine looking back from life’s end—not to frighten yourself, but to rank.
2. Demand — Which current demand disappears?
3. Remain Relationship — Which relationship, integrity choice, health need, or contribution remains?
4. Give Surviving — Give the surviving priority one concrete slot today.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Give Surviving and leave the game there.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Give yourself one second before Imagine Back: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Remain Relationship, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Give Surviving, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Leave the exercise with this: Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Suffering should not absorb the entire identity budget.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Describe Hurting to Choose Small.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 PAIN IS PRESENT; LIFE HAS OTHER DEPARTMENTS // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Describe Hurting — Say exactly what is hurting.
2. Continue Alongside — Then Name three processes continuing alongside it: caring, learning, digesting, noticing, working, resting, relating.
3. Choose Small — Choose one small action from a continuing department without denying the pain.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Small closes the round.

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Existential inquiry needs boundaries to coexist with living.

GAME MOVE
Take the shortest route: Set A Thinking Time → the middle moves → Return To Life.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 GIVE THE BIG QUESTION A ROOM, NOT THE HOUSE // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

1. Set A Thinking Time — Choose a short time for the big question.
2. Enter With One Question — Think about one clear question and stop when the time ends. You do not need a final answer.

WHERE EXACTLY IS THE OBSERVER?

TRIGGER
Boundaries & over-responsibility

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Use Where Exactly Is The Observer? when your responsibility and someone else's have blurred together. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.

GOAL
Test whether the witness has a fixed address.

GAME MOVE
Take the shortest route: Search Carefully → the middle moves → Rest Inability.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WHERE EXACTLY IS THE OBSERVER? // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Search Carefully — Search carefully for the boundary, size, and location of the one who observes.
2. Check Behind — Check behind the eyes, chest, head, and surrounding field.
3. Observe Found — Every found sensation is itself observed.
4. Rest Inability — Rest with the inability to locate a final point.

⚡ END MOVE — Rest Inability. No second lap.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Just before you start Search Carefully, notice one sound in the room before continuing.
2. At Observe Found, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Rest Inability, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: Test whether the witness has a fixed address.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
At Rest Inability, you have at least one option the first reaction did not show you.

📸 MY RESULT
“I just found where my responsibility ends.”

FORMULA FLOW
Search Carefully → Check Behind → Observe Found → Rest Inability

rituals.goal_why_game_move:

One round only: enter at Observe Moment, finish at Choose Position.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 ROTATE THE OBSERVATION DECK // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Observe Moment — Observe the same moment from three positions: body-centred, environment-centred, and whole-field.
2. Hold In Your Mind Amplifies — Keep what each amplifies and hides.
3. Choose Position — Choose the position best suited to the next task rather than declaring any one neutral.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Choose Position and release the exercise.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Observe Moment, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Hold In Your Mind Amplifies, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Choose Position, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Use this as the exit rule: Every viewpoint edits what becomes prominent.

3. Move Forcing — Revisit later to see what moved without forcing sunshine.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Move Forcing, you are done.

1. When you arrive at Imagine A Path Pressure, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Add Shelter, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Move Forcing, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep only this lesson: You are the landscape experiencing weather, not the storm’s legal name.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
By Move Forcing, the first reaction is no longer the only move on the table.

“The feeling was real. It still wasn't the whole evidence.”

Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

GOAL
Inherited rules often feel like your own after the source fades.

GAME MOVE
Let Name Modelled begin the game. Let Ask Whether end it.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WHOSE HANDWRITING IS ON THIS BELIEF? // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Name Modelled — Name who modelled, rewarded, enforced, or normalised the belief.
2. Picture Original — Picture the original context and what compliance protected.
3. Ask Whether — Then ask whether current-you endorses it under present values and evidence.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Ask Whether and leave the game there.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Give yourself one second before Name Modelled: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Picture Original, separate what you know from what you are predicting.
3. When you reach Ask Whether, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Leave the exercise with this: Inherited rules often feel like your own after the source fades.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MOVE THE RULE BETWEEN WORLDS // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. State Rule — Picture the rule without naming who taught it.
2. Change Context — Place it in three contrasting settings—for example family, workplace, and friendship—with different power and consequences.
3. Compare Effects — Compare who is protected, restricted, or harmed in each setting.
4. Keep Core — Keep only the part that remains ethical and workable across contexts; Notice the rest as conditional.

⚡ DONE — Complete Keep Core, then return to your day.

GOAL

GAME MOVE
Use Name Mind as the doorway and Group Exists as the exit.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CHANGE THE COMPARISON DENOMINATOR // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Name Mind — Name the group your mind selected.
2. Match Resources — Substitute a baseline matched on starting point, resources, time, responsibilities, and opportunity.
3. Compare Progress — Compare progress with context included.
4. Group Exists — If no fair group exists, use your own prior trajectory.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Group Exists is your cue to stop.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Name Mind, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Compare Progress, replace “definitely” with an honest percentage.
3. When you reach Group Exists, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: A distorted reference group can manufacture failure.

rituals.text:
CHANGE THE COMPARISON DENOMINATOR

TRIGGER
Comparison & rejection

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
When someone else's life has become the ruler for yours, Change The Comparison Denominator makes the invisible part of the pattern easier to catch.

GOAL
A distorted reference group can manufacture failure.

GAME MOVE
Use Name Mind as the doorway and Group Exists as the exit.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CHANGE THE COMPARISON DENOMINATOR // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Name Mind — Name the group your mind selected.
2. Match Resources — Substitute a baseline matched on starting point, resources, time, responsibilities, and opportunity.
3. Compare Progress — Compare progress with context included.
4. Group Exists — If no fair group exists, use your own prior trajectory.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Group Exists is your cue to stop.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Name Mind, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Compare Progress, replace “definitely” with an honest percentage.
3. When you reach Group Exists, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: A distorted reference group can manufacture failure.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You reach Group Exists without having to solve the entire situation.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped measuring my whole life against one snapshot.”

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.

GAME MOVE
Let Choose Charged begin the game. Let Return Seen end it.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WORD MELT // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Choose Charged — Choose one charged word—not a whole painful story.
2. Say Gently — Say it gently and steadily for about twenty seconds.
3. Listen Moment — Listen for the moment it becomes rhythm, mouth movement, or noise.
4. Stop Room — Stop there and look around the room.
5. Return Seen — Meaning may return; you have seen it separate once.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Return Seen and leave the game there.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Give yourself one second before Choose Charged: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Listen Moment, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Return Seen, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: Repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.

items.text_plain:
WORD MELT

TRIGGER
Automatic habits & autopilot

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
When the old reaction is running before you notice it, Word Melt makes the invisible part of the pattern easier to catch.

GOAL
Repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.

GAME MOVE
Let Choose Charged begin the game. Let Return Seen end it.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WORD MELT // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Choose Charged — Choose one charged word—not a whole painful story.
2. Say Gently — Say it gently and steadily for about twenty seconds.
3. Listen Moment — Listen for the moment it becomes rhythm, mouth movement, or noise.
4. Stop Room — Stop there and look around the room.
5. Return Seen — Meaning may return; you have seen it separate once.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Return Seen and leave the game there.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Give yourself one second before Choose Charged: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Listen Moment, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Return Seen, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: Repeat the sound until the spell loses its language.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You notice the pull of the old pattern and can still choose Return Seen.

📸 MY RESULT
“I caught the pattern early enough to choose.”

⚡ EXIT — Finish Set Reopen and leave the game there.

🎮 ENOUGH IS A CURRENT FACT // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Identify Part — Spot one part of the present condition that is genuinely adequate: shelter, breath, effort, support, knowledge, or time for the next step.
2. Receive Adequacy — Receive that adequacy without claiming everything is fine.
3. Choose Non — From this base, choose one non-desperate improvement.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Non closes the round.

items.trigger_play_time:

Urges, impulses & cravings

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

Change One Thing, Watch One Feeling is a tiny mind game for the moment when several feelings have merged into one heavy mass.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Two feelings untangle when one scene change moves only one of them.

GAME MOVE
Touch Name Pair, follow the moves, and finish on Tag Driver.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CHANGE ONE THING, WATCH ONE FEELING // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Name Pair — Name two emotions in the mixture and rate each with a simple low, medium, or high—not a number.
2. Hold Scene — Hold the scene steady. Choose only one variable to test: person, time, place, audience, or outcome.
3. Swap Variable — Imagine that one variable changed for ten seconds. Keep every other fact the same.
4. Tag Driver — Notice which emotion moved and which stayed. Tag the changed variable as a likely driver, not a final explanation.

⚡ DONE — Complete Tag Driver, then return to your day.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. At the start of Name Pair, widen your gaze and notice the edges of the room.
2. At Swap Variable, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Tag Driver, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep only this lesson: Two feelings untangle when one scene change moves only one of them.

📸 MY RESULT

items.plain:
CHANGE ONE THING, WATCH ONE FEELING

TRIGGER
Urges, impulses & cravings

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Change One Thing, Watch One Feeling is a tiny mind game for the moment when several feelings have merged into one heavy mass.

GOAL
Two feelings untangle when one scene change moves only one of them.

GAME MOVE
Touch Name Pair, follow the moves, and finish on Tag Driver.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CHANGE ONE THING, WATCH ONE FEELING // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Name Pair — Name two emotions in the mixture and rate each with a simple low, medium, or high—not a number.
2. Hold Scene — Hold the scene steady. Choose only one variable to test: person, time, place, audience, or outcome.
3. Swap Variable — Imagine that one variable changed for ten seconds. Keep every other fact the same.
4. Tag Driver — Notice which emotion moved and which stayed. Tag the changed variable as a likely driver, not a final explanation.

⚡ DONE — Complete Tag Driver, then return to your day.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. At the start of Name Pair, widen your gaze and notice the edges of the room.
2. At Swap Variable, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Tag Driver, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep only this lesson: Two feelings untangle when one scene change moves only one of them.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
The old reaction loses a little speed before Tag Driver.

📸 MY RESULT
“The feeling wasn't one giant thing; it had parts.”

FORMULA FLOW
Name Pair → Hold Scene → Swap Variable → Tag Driver

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 TWO CHAIRS, NO TELEPATHY // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Place Chairs — Place two chairs apart.
2. Speak Position — Speak from your position using first person.
3. Switch Chair — Move and answer as the other position, labelling imagination where knowledge is missing.
4. Dont And — Return to your chair and state what changed, what did not, and what real conversation may still be needed.

⚡ FINISH — Dont And closes the round.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 TELL IT AT THE SPEED OF SAFETY // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. Choose Trustworthy — Choose a trustworthy listener and agree on time, confidentiality, and a stop signal.
2. Share — Share facts first, then feelings and meaning in tolerable detail.
3. Pause Orient — Pause to orient between sections.
4. End Support — End with what support you want now—not what the listener guesses.

⚡ DONE — Complete End Support, then return to your day.

TRIGGER

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A warning must become testable before it can command you.

GAME MOVE
One round only: enter at Pin Forecast, finish at Update Odds.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MAKE FEAR NAME A DEADLINE // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Pin Forecast — Rewrite the fear as one visible or audible forecast—not a vague catastrophe.
2. Set Clock — Give the forecast a real time window.
3. Score Odds — Set confidence from 0 to 100 before checking anything.
4. Observe Safely — Use only a naturally occurring safe observation; never manufacture a test.
5. Update Odds — Hold the result and update confidence in either direction.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Update Odds and release the exercise.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Pin Forecast, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Score Odds, look for the piece of evidence your first reaction ignored.
3. When you reach Update Odds, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Use this as the exit rule: A warning must become testable before it can command you.

🎮 GROUNDING ANCHOR RELAY // PLAY

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.

GAME MOVE
Enter through Read Channels; leave as soon as you reach Check Panel. One pass is enough.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 DISASSEMBLE THE ALARM PANEL // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. Read Channels — Read three channels without searching your whole body: SPEED, PRESSURE, and TEMPERATURE. Use low, medium, or high.
2. Pick Smallest — Choose the safest channel with the lowest intensity. Do not pick the loudest one.
3. Move Dial — Move only that channel one step: slow one hand movement, soften one contact point, or adjust one safe layer of warmth or coolness.
4. Check Panel — Check whether that channel changed at all. Let the other two channels remain exactly as they are.

⚡ DONE — Complete Check Panel, then return to your day.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. At the start of Read Channels, widen your gaze and notice the edges of the room.
2. At Move Dial, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Check Panel, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep the clean version: The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.

3. Move Dial — Move only that channel one step: slow one hand movement, soften one contact point, or adjust one safe layer of warmth or coolness.
4. Check Panel — Check whether that channel changed at all. Let the other two channels remain exactly as they are.

⚡ DONE — Complete Check Panel, then return to your day.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. At the start of Read Channels, widen your gaze and notice the edges of the room.
2. At Move Dial, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Check Panel, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep the clean version: The whole alarm does not need to stop before one dial can move.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
A small gap appears between the reaction and what you do at Check Panel.

📸 MY RESULT
“My body sounded an alarm; I didn't have to turn it into danger.”

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 EXIST FOR ONE MINUTE WITHOUT AUTOBIOGRAPHY // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. Dont Recall — For sixty seconds, do not recall name, history, status, or plans.
2. Stay Changing — Stay with changing sound, pressure, light, and movement.
3. Simple — Notice the simple ongoing sense of being present through those changes.
4. End Reclaim — Reclaim your biography on purpose at the end.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach End Reclaim, you are done.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
What someone did is not your identity property.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Imagine Three Boxes to Act From Choice.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 RETURN THEIR ACTION; KEEP YOUR CHOICE // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Imagine Three Boxes — Imagine three boxes: WHAT THEY DID; WHAT I LEARNED; WHAT I CHOOSE NOW.
2. Keep Each Part — Keep each thought in the right box.
3. Do Not Force Forgiveness — You do not have to forgive on command.
4. Act From Choice — Take one action from the third box.

⚡ FINISH — Act From Choice closes the round.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Imagine Three Boxes, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Do Not Force Forgiveness, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Act From Choice, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: What someone did is not your identity property.

TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
When your mind keeps circling without finding anything new, Return Their Action; Keep Your Choice gives you something concrete to do with the moment.

GOAL
What someone did is not your identity property.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Imagine Three Boxes to Act From Choice.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 RETURN THEIR ACTION; KEEP YOUR CHOICE // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Imagine Three Boxes — Imagine three boxes: WHAT THEY DID; WHAT I LEARNED; WHAT I CHOOSE NOW.
2. Keep Each Part — Keep each thought in the right box.
3. Do Not Force Forgiveness — You do not have to forgive on command.
4. Act From Choice — Take one action from the third box.

⚡ FINISH — Act From Choice closes the round.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Imagine Three Boxes, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Do Not Force Forgiveness, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Act From Choice, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: What someone did is not your identity property.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can reach Act From Choice with more choice than you had at Imagine Three Boxes.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped circling and found the next useful point.”

FORMULA FLOW
Imagine Three Boxes → Keep Each Part → Do Not Force Forgiveness → Act From Choice

items.name: MATCH THE TASK TO THE BODY’S TEMPERATURE
items.ritual_name: MATCH THE TASK TO THE BODY’S TEMPERATURE
items.unique_game_move: Start at Read Body and keep going only until Reassess.
items.recognition_cue: When your body alarm keeps turning itself up, Match The Task To The Body’S Temperature makes the invisible part of the pattern easier to catch.
items.situation: When your body alarm keeps turning itself up, Match The Task To The Body’S Temperature makes the invisible part of the pattern easier to catch.
items.immediate_need: Action fails when stimulation and state are badly paired.
items.challenge: Action fails when stimulation and state are badly paired.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
When your body alarm keeps turning itself up, Match The Task To The Body’S Temperature makes the invisible part of the pattern easier to catch.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Action fails when stimulation and state are badly paired.

GAME MOVE
Start at Read Body and keep going only until Reassess.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MATCH THE TASK TO THE BODY’S TEMPERATURE // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Read Body — Read current body alarm as low, medium, or high.
2. Select Work — Select work with matching demand: energising movement for low, steady production for medium, simple contained tasks for high.
3. Reassess — Reassess after one unit and change lanes if needed.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Reassess is your cue to stop.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Read Body, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Select Work, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Reassess, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: Action fails when stimulation and state are badly paired.

items.plain:
SETTLE WITHOUT USING BREATH

TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Settle Without Using Breath gives you a quick reset for the moment when your mind keeps circling without finding anything new.

GOAL
When respiration is a trigger, use other doors.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Choose Pressure to Channel.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SETTLE WITHOUT USING BREATH // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Choose Pressure — Choose pressure from a surface, steady gaze, mild temperature, and slow movement.
2. Check Sequence — Sequence them without checking breathing.
3. Channel — Notice which channel restores the clearest sense of where you are and keep only that one for the final interval.

⚡ FINISH — Channel closes the round.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Choose Pressure, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Check Sequence, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Channel, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: When respiration is a trigger, use other doors.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can hold the discomfort and still make the move at Channel.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped circling and found the next useful point.”

FORMULA FLOW
Choose Pressure → Check Sequence → Channel

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 UNWIND IN REVERSE // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

1. Recall Muscle — Recall which muscle group tightened last.
2. Soften Work — Soften it first, then work back toward the first area that braced.
3. Pause Handoff — Pause between groups to feel the handoff.
4. Finish Original — Finish at the original starting point and compare the whole chain.

⚡ END MOVE — Finish Original. No second lap.

items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
When your body alarm keeps turning itself up, Which Way Does The Urge Point? makes the invisible part of the pattern easier to catch.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Body alarm becomes clearer when given a vector.

GAME MOVE
Use Act Classify as the doorway and Ask Safe as the exit.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WHICH WAY DOES THE URGE POINT? // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Act Classify — Without acting, classify the bodily impulse as toward, away, against, downward, upward, or still.
2. Body — Notice the body region carrying the arrow.
3. Ask Safe — Ask what safe action could honour the information without blindly completing the vector.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Ask Safe is your cue to stop.

Start at Take Small and keep going only until Wanting.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 LET ONE TASTE FINISH // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Take Small — Take one small bite or sip.
2. Track Taste — Track taste from first contact through peak, transformation, and complete disappearance.
3. Dont Add — Do not add another until the original flavour has ended.
4. Wanting — Notice the exact point where wanting separates from tasting.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Wanting is your cue to stop.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A private intention is weakest where renegotiation begins.

GAME MOVE
Begin where it says Identify Decision; stop the moment you complete State Action.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 PUT THE PROMISE AT THE CROSSROADS // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Identify Decision — Spot the exact decision moment and place a visible commitment there: Notice on the door, calendar alert, prepared object, or message to an agreed supporter.
2. State Action — The cue must state the action, not a motivational slogan.

⚡ CLOSE — Let State Action be enough.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Identify Decision, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At State Action, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach State Action, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: A private intention is weakest where renegotiation begins.

Action avoidance & procrastination

about 90 seconds

HOOK
When your mind keeps delaying the first move, Put The Promise At The Crossroads gives you something concrete to do with the moment.

A private intention is weakest where renegotiation begins.

Begin where it says Identify Decision; stop the moment you complete State Action.

🎮 PUT THE PROMISE AT THE CROSSROADS // PLAY

2. State Action — The cue must state the action, not a motivational slogan.

⚡ CLOSE — Let State Action be enough.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Identify Decision, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At State Action, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach State Action, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: A private intention is weakest where renegotiation begins.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can complete State Action without needing perfect certainty first.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped waiting to feel ready and found one move I could do.”

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 FIND YOUR WORKING GEAR // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Run Pulse — Choose one ordinary task and run it for exactly thirty seconds without trying to finish it.
2. Full Stop — Stop completely for fifteen seconds. Hands off, eyes away, and no planning the next move.
3. Read Strain — Rate actual strain as light, workable, heavy, or stop. Compare it with what you predicted before starting.
4. Set Gear — Choose the next gear—30/15, 60/30, or stop—and complete exactly one more cycle at that ratio.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Set Gear and release the exercise.

Automatic habits & autopilot

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
When the old reaction is running before you notice it, Five Clues May Be One Clue gives you something concrete to do with the moment.

GOAL
Several clues can be one echo wearing different clothes.

GAME MOVE
Start at Name Clues. Stop at Recheck Claim. Let the middle do the work.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 FIVE CLUES MAY BE ONE CLUE // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Name Clues — Name up to five clues currently supporting the worried conclusion.
2. Link Sources — Imagine a line between clues that came from the same person, event, article, assumption, mood, or repeated retelling.
3. Collapse Copies — Collapse every linked cluster into one source family; do not count its echoes separately.
4. Recheck Claim — Recheck the claim using the number and quality of independent families that remain.

⚡ FINISH — Recheck Claim closes the round.

1. Before you begin Name Clues, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Collapse Copies, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Recheck Claim, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Several clues can be one echo wearing different clothes.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can reach Recheck Claim with more choice than you had at Name Clues.

📸 MY RESULT
“I caught the pattern early enough to choose.”

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.

GAME MOVE
Let Imagine Back begin the game. Let Give Surviving end it.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE LAST-DAY FILTER // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Imagine Back — Imagine looking back from life’s end—not to frighten yourself, but to rank.
2. Demand — Which current demand disappears?
3. Remain Relationship — Which relationship, integrity choice, health need, or contribution remains?
4. Give Surviving — Give the surviving priority one concrete slot today.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Give Surviving and leave the game there.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Give yourself one second before Imagine Back: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Remain Relationship, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Give Surviving, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Leave the exercise with this: Finite life can expose counterfeit urgency.

📸 MY RESULT
“I created one beat between 'now' and 'do it.'”

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 PAIN IS PRESENT; LIFE HAS OTHER DEPARTMENTS // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Describe Hurting — Say exactly what is hurting.
2. Continue Alongside — Then Name three processes continuing alongside it: caring, learning, digesting, noticing, working, resting, relating.
3. Choose Small — Choose one small action from a continuing department without denying the pain.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Small closes the round.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 IMAGINE TODAY’S EMOTIONAL WEATHER // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Imagine A Path Pressure — Imagine a path pressure zones, temperature, movement direction, visibility, and likely forecast using colours or symbols.
2. Add Shelter — Add one shelter and one safe travel route.

items.text:
FOUR-CELL DECISION MATRIX

TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Four-Cell Decision Matrix gives you a quick reset for the moment when a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact.

GOAL
Separate value from danger before emotion blends them.

GAME MOVE
Open at Score Option; close at Prefer Option. Keep it light and literal.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 FOUR-CELL DECISION MATRIX // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Score Option — Score each option on value alignment, downside, reversibility, and learning.
2. Add Sentence — Add a sentence explaining every score.
3. Compare Patterns — Compare patterns rather than relying on the total alone.
4. Prefer Option — Prefer the option whose risk can be contained while important value is expressed.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Prefer Option be enough.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Score Option, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Compare Patterns, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Prefer Option, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Separate value from danger before emotion blends them.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can finish at Prefer Option even if the original thought has not completely disappeared.

📸 MY RESULT
“The feeling was real. It still wasn't the whole evidence.”

Score Option → Add Sentence → Compare Patterns → Prefer Option

GOAL

Start with Say About. When Whether appears, the round is over.

🎮 REMOVE WHAT THE CHOICE WOULD ‘PROVE’ // PLAY

2. Cross Out — Cross out those identity messages.
3. Re — Re-check only consequences, values, constraints, and evidence.
4. Whether — Notice whether the preferred option changes.

⚡ END MOVE — Whether. No second lap.

2. At Re, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Whether, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: Identity signalling can distort an otherwise practical decision.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MOVE THE RULE BETWEEN WORLDS // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. State Rule — Picture the rule without naming who taught it.
2. Change Context — Place it in three contrasting settings—for example family, workplace, and friendship—with different power and consequences.
3. Compare Effects — Compare who is protected, restricted, or harmed in each setting.
4. Keep Core — Keep only the part that remains ethical and workable across contexts; Notice the rest as conditional.

⚡ DONE — Complete Keep Core, then return to your day.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 DO ONE GOOD THING WITH NO APPLAUSE BUTTON // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Choose Safe — Choose a safe act you endorse and perform it without announcing, checking reactions, or fishing for reassurance.
2. Let Discomfort — Let the discomfort of no feedback rise and change.
3. Review — Review the action by your values afterward.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Review be enough.
